Emscripten and WebGPU bridge source notices
==========================================

Original per-file copyright/license headers from the installed Emscripten 6.0.13
and Emdawnwebgpu sources. Source-wide retention is conservative; some listed
modules are not linked by this game. The full MIT license and the upstream
NCSA alternative are in LICENSE_Emscripten.txt and LICENSE_EmdawnWebGPU.txt.

 * @license
 * Copyright 2010 The Emscripten Authors

 *
 * Legacy library symbols that are no longer used by emscripten itself but
 * could have external users.
 *
 * Symbols in this file are not available in `-sSTRICT` mode.
 *
 * Any usage of symbols in this file will result in a `-Wdeprecated` warning.
 *
 * Symbol in this file should be removed after 'enough time' has passed such
 * that all external users have been able to transition away.
 */
